Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) __wherein the BVDV-lb is derived from a non-cytopathic parent virus and attenuated to produce a cytopathic phenotype__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the composition comprises only the modified, live BVDV-lb and does not further comprise__ one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the composition comprises only the modified, live BVDV-lb and does not further comprise__ a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __wherein the composition does not further comprise__ an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, __wherein the at least a first antigen, if present, is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof__.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, __wherein the at least a first antigen, if present, is inactivated__.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, __which does not further comprise__ an immunologically-effective amount of a least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen.
